claim.scope_statement: Rohatgi (2019) explicitly gives an OVC-conditional negative answer to Basu's proposed uniform general-rank exact $O(nr^2\log n)$ assignment bound. This report identifies that published answer and its input/model qualifications. It does not settle fixed rank two, give an unconditional lower bound, or claim a new theorem.

evidence.note:
The original Medium-setting work was checked by a separate, fresh OpenAI gpt-6.1-sol context at **High**, a listed qualifying model/setting. Provider, model identifier and effort were verified from that review session's own metadata; exact serving revision and time budget are unknown. The reviewer did not draft this report. No previously demonstrated multi-agent architecture is claimed.

The independent check returned **PASS for mathematical/source correspondence**: Basu's complete original question; Rohatgi's literal Theorem 2 and OVC statement; Appendix A/Theorem 18, squared costs, explicit factors and dimension overhead; maximum/minimum and cost/permutation distinctions; fixed-rank-two limitations; and the absence of this citation in the earlier archive contribution. The reviewer independently refetched the primary sources linked in References and matched their bytes to those inspected for this report. This check does not re-prove all external hardness results or certify an exhausti

ve literature search.
